issue.body:
## Goal

Ensure the default Structural delta graph represents every selected, directly changed structural anchor, including changed tests, without expanding into a repository-reachable graph dump.

## Requirements

- A selected direct changed structural anchor is eligible for default backbone membership regardless of whether its focus-relative evidence annotation is primary, test support, or documentation support.
- Focus-relative evidence annotation remains available for reviewer explanation and presentation, but cannot add, remove, or suppress structural backbone membership.
- The same membership contract applies to Issue R/G and PR Transformation/Completion subjects.
- Intermediate, retained-context, and merely reachable support nodes remain outside the default backbone unless canonical backbone rules independently include them.
- The graph retains direct production and direct test changes together when both are selected.

## Guardrails

- Do not change Codegraph collection, traversal budgets, changed-anchor association, assessment, LLM behavior, or graph layout.
- Do not promote all reachable structural support nodes.
- Do not introduce a second backbone producer or renderer-side membership decision.

## Verification expectations

- A deterministic fixture demonstrates a directly changed production anchor and directly changed test anchors in the default backbone.
- A primary intermediate/context node remains excluded.
- The final rendered graph consumes the canonical backbone result and visibly includes the changed test anchor.

## Scope

Canonical changed-backbone membership from selected structural overlays through the review graph projection and renderer sink.

## Out of scope

Traversal convergence, support-path relevance, LLM inference, assessment semantics, and visual-layout redesign.

## Uncertainties

Provider truncation can still limit discovered relations; this work must not infer undiscovered structure.
issue.title: Preserve directly changed test anchors in the structural backbone

pull_request.body:
Closes #207

## Parent transformation and responsibility

Continue the canonical structural graph projection: make directly changed structural-anchor membership independent of focus-relative evidence annotation.

## Semantic output and sinks

The output is the default Structural delta graph backbone. Its production sinks are ReviewStructuralGraph.backbone_node_ids, _change_backbone, and the renderer that consumes those IDs.

## Before topology

R/G selected structural overlays
→ inspect primary evidence role
→ backbone seed

T/CC selected structural overlays
→ inspect changed-anchor node role
→ backbone seed

A directly changed test anchor was classified as test support and therefore omitted from the R/G backbone despite being selected and structurally mapped.

## After topology

R/G and T/CC selected structural overlays
→ changed-anchor node role
→ canonical seed derivation
→ _change_backbone
→ ReviewStructuralGraph
→ renderer

## Affected contracts

- Structural membership is determined only by selected direct changed-anchor role.
- Primary, test-support, and document-support remain focus-relative evidence annotations; they do not grant or deny membership.
- Intermediate/context nodes remain non-seeds unless existing backbone expansion independently reaches them.
- The renderer remains a consumer of canonical graph membership and does not reconstruct it.

## Migration and removal

- Remove the R/G-only relation/evidence-role filter from canonical seed derivation.
- Remove the relations input from the seed API, so it cannot re-decide membership from evidence annotation.
- Retain _change_backbone as the only backbone producer and preserve bounded one-hop support behavior.

## Counterfactual and sink evidence

- One selected production anchor plus two selected test-support anchors enter backbone_node_ids and are visible in rendered HTML.
- A primary intermediate node remains excluded.
- Existing context and reachable support are not promoted merely because a changed test anchor is visible.

## Stable invariant and enforcement

- Invariant: focus-relative evidence annotation cannot add, remove, or suppress a directly selected changed structural member.
- Before: a relation-role branch in seed derivation violated the invariant.
- Target enforcement: the canonical seed API accepts only structural overlays and filters solely on node role; projection and renderer sink tests exercise the two counterfactuals.
- This is sufficient because relation annotations are no longer available at the membership boundary. A broader static gate or new domain type would not exclude an additional concrete transition.

## Verification

- 379 passed
- git diff --check passes
- Codegraph synchronized; producer-to-sink census finds one seed producer feeding _change_backbone and the renderer consumer.

## Unresolved surfaces

Codegraph/provider truncation may still limit discovered relations. This PR neither infers missing structure nor changes traversal, association, assessment, LLM behavior, or layout.

## Merge gates

- Responsibility closure: complete.
- Contract closure: complete; R/G and T/CC now consume the same membership contract.
- Abandonment safety: complete; no subsequent PR is required for directly changed test anchors to remain visible.
- Parent completion: open; broader structural evidence evolution remains separately scoped.
pull_request.title: Preserve directly changed anchors in structural backbone
